Iterate copy: for x in list[:]. Use comprehension. Iterate backwards.

any(): first True. all(): first False. Short-circuit.

continue: skip iteration. break: exit loop. Innermost only.
r: read. w: write. a: append. b: binary. +: read/write.
with open() as f: ensures file closed.
split() break into list. split(sep, maxsplit) customize.
join() combine list. Efficient vs concatenation.
replace(old, new, count) change text. Returns new string.
strip() remove whitespace. lstrip(), rstrip() sides.
keys() all keys. Iterate for membership test.
values() all values. Iterate over values.
items() key-value pairs. for k, v in d.items().
get(key, default) safe. Returns default if missing.
append(item) add to end. Returns None.
extend(items) add multiple. vs append() adds as one.
remove(value) delete first. ValueError if missing.
pop(index) remove and return. pop() last.
copy() shallow copy. Nested objects still referenced.
type(obj) exact type. Use isinstance() for inheritance.
[x for x in range(10)]. [x for x if condition].
{x for x in range(10)}. Removes duplicates.
{k: v for k, v in d.items()}. {v: k for k, v in d.items()}.
lambda x: x**2 anonymous. Use map/filter. Avoid complex logic.
try: attempt. except Error: catch. finally: always.
else: runs if no exception. Not skipped if except.

Code style guide. 4 spaces indent, 79 char max, snake_case names. Improves consistency.
20 Python design principles. 'Explicit better than implicit'. 'Simple better than complex'.

None represents absence. Singleton. Is used for None check. Default return value.

Environment variable. Python installation directory. Rarely needed, auto-detected.
Environment variable. Adds directories to sys.path for imports.
A imports B, B imports A. Can cause issues. Rearrange imports, import inside function.
if condition: block. elif: other condition. else: default. Python not switch.
while condition: block. Repeats while True. break exits. continue skips.
for item in iterable: block. range() for numbers. enumerate() for index+item.

continue skips to next iteration. In while or for. Innermost loop only.

Loop inside loop. break/continue affects innermost. Use function to break outer.
Text data. Single/double quotes same. Escape with \. Raw strings r'\n'.

upper(), lower(), capitalize(), title(). strip(), replace(), split(), join().

append(), extend(), insert(), remove(), pop(), sort(), reverse(), copy().

keys(), values(), items(), get(), pop(), update(), clear(), copy().

is, is not. Check object identity not value. Use for None.
in, not in. Check container membership. Works with strings, lists, sets, dicts.

return value. Multiple: return x, y (tuple). None if no return.

global x inside function. Access/modify module-level x.
nonlocal x in nested function. Access/modify enclosing x.
Function inside function. Inner accesses outer scope. Enclosing scope captured.
lambda params: expr. Anonymous function. lambda x: x**2.
Lambda for small functions. def for complex. Both create function objects.
